categories.main_business_segments: Osaki Electric Co., Ltd. operates three main business segments: Domestic Measurement and Control (focusing on smart meters, instrument transformers, energy management systems, smart locks, and switchboards), Overseas Measurement and Control (primarily smart meters and related systems), and Real Estate (property leasing). The company and its 24 subsidiaries provide products and services across these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include advanced smart metering, AC/DC measurement, monitoring and control, energy management, and AIoT utilization. Manufacturing is supported by both in-house and outsourced production, with a focus on quality management and continuous product improvement. R&D emphasizes next-generation smart meters, digital solutions, and energy-saving technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are electric utilities (notably major Japanese power companies such as Kansai Electric Power), multi-site retailers, property management firms, and industrial/commercial facility operators. Overseas, the company serves utilities and infrastructure providers in Oceania, Europe, Asia, and emerging markets, with a growing focus on energy management and decarbonization solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Osaki Electric has a strong presence in Japan and significant operations in Oceania (especially Australia), Europe (notably the UK), and Asia (including Singapore, China, and Malaysia). Overseas sales account for about 40% of total revenue, with business expansion targeting Europe, Oceania, Asia, and the Middle East/Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, designing, manufacturing, and supplying smart meters, control systems, and solutions to utilities and end-users. It also provides after-sales services and solutions, and manages a real estate leasing business.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing group synergies, expanding smart meter and solution businesses, supporting digital transformation (DX) for customers, and providing decarbonization (GX) services. R&D focuses on next-generation smart meters, energy management, digital solutions, and new business domains, with an emphasis on sustainability and global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales (smart meters, control systems, smart locks), solution and service contracts (energy management, DX/GX solutions), and real estate leasing. The company also receives royalties and licensing income from certain overseas operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include domestic and international smart meter and energy management system providers. Osaki Electric is a leading player in Japan and has a strong global presence, particularly in Oceania and the UK, positioning itself as a 'Global Energy Solution Leader' with a focus on high-value-added solutions and sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached ¥97.1 billion, with operating profit of ¥5.7 billion and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥3.5 billion. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profitability, with a mid-term plan targeting ¥100 billion in sales and ¥9 billion in operating profit by FY2026/27. The group employs approximately 2,558 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Osaki Electric differentiates itself through advanced smart metering technology, integrated energy management solutions, and a strong commitment to sustainability and decarbonization. The company emphasizes 'visualizing the invisible' to create new social value, offering high-quality, reliable products and tailored solutions that address customer needs for efficiency, digital transformation, and environmental responsibility.
